init_RCDM: initialize an RCDM model with SSL backbone and diffusion model from args configuration
forward_RCDM_generate_samples: generate image samples from a batch of images or image file path using RCDM forward pass
forward_RCDM_single_image: generate num_samples images from a single image file path using the RCDM model
init_RCDM_ssl_model: initialize the SSL model for feature extraction with a specified model type and head
init_RCDM_diffusion: create and configure the diffusion model with feature conditioning and SSL dimensions
